outcome: Identify and use tenses or other structures that express present, past and future in the language studied.
Use and manipulate key grammatical structures and patterns, including voices and moods where relevant.
Build a wide, deepening vocabulary beyond immediate needs to give and justify opinions and discuss wider issues.
Use accurate grammar, spelling and punctuation.
Listen to varied spoken language to get information and respond appropriately.
Transcribe heard words and short sentences with increasing accuracy.
Start and sustain conversations, coping with unfamiliar language and unexpected replies and using social conventions such as formal address.
Express and develop ideas clearly and accurately in speech and writing.
Speak coherently and confidently with increasingly accurate pronunciation and intonation.
Read original and adapted materials, understand purpose, main ideas and details, and translate short suitable texts into English.
Read literary texts such as stories, songs, poems and letters to spark ideas, creative expression and cultural understanding.
Write prose with a widening range of grammar and vocabulary, write creatively about own ideas and opinions, and translate short texts into the language.
